name: 冰封怨灵
evolution: 雪娃娃 → 冰封怨灵 Lv.26 → 雪灵 Lv.42
description: 缔结契约的向往更明显，甚至会主动靠近潜在契约者，似乎由冰元素和某种尚不清楚的物质构成，推测该物质来自强烈的信念与精神力，使它们的契约更稳定、也更难被外力改变。
descriptionEn: Its desire to form contracts is more obvious, and it even actively approaches potential contractors. It seems to be composed of ice element and some unknown substance, which is speculated to come from strong belief and mental power, making their contracts more stable and harder to change by external forces.

skills.name: 冰锥
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 激怒
skills.description: 敌方除本回合使用的技能，其他技能能耗+3，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy's skills other than the one used this turn gain +3 energy cost for 3 turns.

skills.name: 丢冰块
skills.description: 造成物伤，敌方获得速度-30。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; enemy gains Speed -30.

skills.name: 雾气环绕
skills.description: 回复能量，回复值等于敌方技能总能耗的一半。
skills.descriptionEn: Restores energy equal to half of the enemy's total skill energy cost.

skills.name: 雪替身
skills.description: 减伤70%，应对攻击：回复能量，回复值等于被应对技能能耗的2倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%; against attacks: restores energy equal to twice the energy cost of the responded skill.

skills.name: 聒噪
skills.description: 敌方获得全攻击技能能耗+2，持续3回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains +2 energy cost to all attack skills for 3 turns.

skills.name: 冰锋横扫
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能威力等于敌方精灵技能总能耗的10倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; this skill's power equals 10 times the enemy's total skill energy cost.

skills.name: 冰捆缚
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击敌方获得全技能能耗+1。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit makes the enemy gain +1 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 速冻
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains 2 layers of Slow mark.

skills.name: 冰冻光线
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方获得全技能能耗+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; enemy gains +2 energy cost to all skills.

skills.name: 冬至
skills.description: 将天气改为暴风雪，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Changes the weather to Blizzard for 8 turns.

skills.name: 瞬间零度
skills.description: 本回合敌方使用的技能能耗+3，应对防御：改为全技能能耗+3。
skills.descriptionEn: This turn the enemy's used skill gains +3 energy cost; against defense: changed to all skills gain +3 energy cost.
